assessment.import_diff: The only delta is replacing registration-time Factory.Config brand resolution with Factory.StartupBrand and its explanatory comment. No shortcut imports, service aliases, callbacks, mounting order, flags or special-domain hooks change.
assessment.snapshot_and_external_commands: Built-ins are initialized once. AllShortcuts returns an isolated snapshot via the existing clone owner; external declarations are separately cloned, then duplicate canonical paths reject the whole external contribution. Registration groups the provided snapshot without mutating the global declarations or adding another clone.
assessment.callbacks_and_runtime: Each declaration still mounts exactly through MountWithContext using the supplied context and Factory. Callback values and captured business state remain governed by the existing mount/clone machinery. Registration introduces no execution wrapper, direct platform request or new credential/config resolution.
assessment.user_visible_and_plugin_semantics: Existing service nodes are reused; domain tags and singular slide alias are applied to both reused and newly created nodes. This preserves parent-domain resolution for plugin selection. Apps helper, mail flag hook and sheets grouping/hints remain installed at the same points. Root plugin enforcement/hooks continue to run after registration over the mounted tree.
assessment.brand_and_flags: Empty startup brand retains the documented unrestricted bootstrap behavior. Known brand restrictions run after all service children are installed, recursively hide the service and replace parsing/pre-run/run paths with the existing typed rejection; unsupported-brand business callbacks remain unreachable. Supported-brand flag declarations and runtime paths are untouched. The startup brand is a build-local input rather than credential-backed help work.

limitations: Review is of this registration file and its direct dependency interactions; it is not a whole-file reapproval of common runtime, credential, plugin, or individual domain implementations.

Direct internal Factory callers must populate StartupBrand to request a known-brand projection; empty metadata intentionally preserves unrestricted bootstrap behavior. Shipped Execute/Build wiring and constructor regressions are covered by the earlier CR-1 review.
Callback closure state remains shared by design; this review does not claim deep isolation of arbitrary values captured inside business functions.
